title: llama.cpp and ggml reach 1.0 with a promise to stop breaking downstream code quietly
summary: The project that made local inference practical on ordinary hardware has shipped llama.cpp v1.0.0 and ggml v1.0.0, more than three years after it started. The commitment is semantic versioning: incompatible API and ABI changes now come with a major-version bump instead of arriving as a routine weekly surprise. For maintainers building on the C API, or on the more than 150 supported architectures, that turns a moving target into something that can be pinned.
